entries.reason: Built-in family barrels are the canonical public data catalog surface. They are referenced through the builtins registry, domain surface registry, docs, and package public exports; individual collection exports must not be removed solely because internal consumers import the family object.

The shared browser host is a Relay-owned connector primitive stored in the root browser folder so Relay server, connector, and tests share one implementation. Relay owns the Playwright runtime dependency; moving or packaging the browser host is a separate ownership cleanup.

Bridge loads the optional native Iroh transport dynamically and degrades to a stub when the native module is absent. The code must not force-install the native transport until the host/runtime transport packaging decision is made.
